Summary: Unvalidated numeric and date boundary inputs in policy payload
Steps to Reproduce: Send negative attendance_cutoff_days (-10), impossible expected_payday (99), or invalid timezone ('Fake/Zone')
Actual Behavior: API returned HTTP 200 and saved invalid values into tenant_settings table
Expected Behavior: API must validate constraints and reject invalid payloads with HTTP 400 Bad Request
Root Cause Analysis: PUT endpoint accepted request body values without range and enumeration guards
Remediation Applied: Added comprehensive input validation in academyRoutes.js checking integer ranges (0-14 cutoff, 5-240 overtime, 1-31 payday), regex/IANA timezone verification via Intl.DateTimeFormat, and divisor enum validation

Summary: Checkbox selectors in Playwright test failed visibility due to opacity: 0 styled toggle switches
Steps to Reproduce: Run Playwright test targeting raw input checkbox #setting-future-attendance
Actual Behavior: Playwright threw element not visible error because modern CSS toggle hides native input
Expected Behavior: Toggle wrapper element should be clickable and assertable in test suites
Root Cause Analysis: Modern UI switch component uses opacity: 0 with peer pseudo-elements for visual representation
Remediation Applied: Updated test locators to target .policy-toggle-switch:has(#setting-future-attendance) and verified checked property via JavaScript evaluation

Summary: Policy changes did not record immutable previous vs updated state diffs in audit_logs
Actual Behavior: tenant_settings table updated, but no entry recorded in tenant audit_logs table
Expected Behavior: Every configuration mutation must log actor, previous settings snapshot, and updated values
Root Cause Analysis: Audit log insertion call was missing from the general policy update route
Remediation Applied: Added structured audit log generation capturing actor_id, actor_name, action 'update_academy_policies', and JSON diff payload containing previous and new settings

Summary: Stale localStorage selectedAcademyId allowed tenant cross-bleed attempt to silently modify default academy instead of throwing 403
Steps to Reproduce: Log in as Academy Admin 1, then send PUT /api/academy/settings/policy with X-Academy-Id: 2 header
Actual Behavior: Before fix, tenant resolver did not cross-check header target against non-superadmin token identity, or defaulted incorrectly
Expected Behavior: API must strictly throw HTTP 403 Forbidden when a non-superadmin attempts cross-tenant access
Root Cause Analysis: tenantResolver.js prioritized token before checking if explicit cross-tenant target was provided in header
Remediation Applied: Updated tenantResolver.js to inspect explicit header targets first, then strictly verify req.user.academyId === targetAcademyId, throwing 403 Forbidden on mismatch
